description: This is a Java test class for the Eclipse Hono project, specifically an integration test for the AMQP telemetry adapter. It extends a base test class and uses JUnit 5 for testing with Vert.x extension. The class defines methods for creating telemetry message consumers and obtaining the endpoint name.

classes.name: TelemetryAmqpIT
classes.description: An integration test class for telemetry over AMQP in the Eclipse Hono project. It extends AmqpUploadTestBase and provides specific implementations for creating telemetry consumers and defining the endpoint.

methods.name: senderQoSTypes
methods.description: Returns a stream of ProtonQoS values used for testing different Quality of Service levels.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates a telemetry message consumer for a specific tenant ID using the application client factory.

methods.name: getEndpointName
methods.description: Returns the endpoint name for telemetry, used in the test configuration.
